explanation.headline: Filgrastim is not on FDA's shortage list; Corvale General has 17.1 days on hand and the top buying option is Sandoz Inc.

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include filgrastim as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 49 vials of the 480 ug/1.6 mL presentation, which at a daily use of 2.9 vials provides 17.1 days on hand.
The rule‑ranked first option is to buy from Sandoz Inc., which is also not on the shortage list today.
A secondary option is to buy from Tanvex BioPharma USA, Inc., also not listed on the shortage list.
A third option is Accord BioPharma Inc., whose label names no plant we could place.

One label for a related product names Kashiv BioSciences, LLC (FEI 3011289655) as a registered plant with operations including manufacture and analysis, last inspected with a VAI classification on 2024-06-14.
FDA inspection records for that plant show a VAI in 2015, an OAI in 2018, and the most recent VAI in 2024.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
